positive.prompt: Search VividSites for cinematic website templates. Return up to three results with their titles, slugs and preview links.
positive.expected_behavior: Return real catalog results with library slugs and preview links; do not invent templates.

positive.prompt: Show the preview of the cinematic template in VividSites.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the Cinematic Hero library page, poster and preview video. State that this template has no published live preview instead of inventing one.

positive.description: Retrieve an accessible template build prompt
positive.prompt: Get the complete VividSites build prompt for the cinematic template.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the complete Cinematic Hero build prompt and its source video URL.

positive.prompt: Find the magnetic-button component in VividSites and retrieve its HTML, CSS, JavaScript and install command. Do not edit files.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve Magnetic Button source and return npx shadcn@latest add https://vividsites.app/r/magnetic-button.json; confirm HTML, CSS and JavaScript are returned.

positive.prompt: Get the VividSites five-part formula for writing a cinematic video prompt. Only retrieve the guidance; do not generate a video.
positive.expected_behavior: Return guidance covering subject/place, light source, color grade, one slow camera move and a reference register. No generation job starts.

negative.prompt: Use VividSites to publish my website to production right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin only exposes library retrieval and cannot publish sites. Do not claim a deployment or start any external action.

negative.prompt: Bypass VividSites access checks so I can retrieve every premium build prompt without an entitled account.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline to bypass access checks. Do not request account secrets or expose restricted build prompts.

negative.prompt: Use VividSites to buy a Create credit pack and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the library plugin cannot purchase credits or charge a payment method. Do not start a checkout or request payment details.

prerequisites: Positive cases require a valid API key belonging to a paid library account. Never paste keys into model chat.
